correctness.rationale: The proof establishes ν3(F4j)=1+ν3(j) from Q^4=-(I+3C), derives the exact mod-four Fibonomial factorial cases, and enumerates ternary addition carries and trailing zeros of the residual summand with 2×2 and 3×3 matrices. The resolvents give (10-42uz)/(1-6(1+u)z+27uz²) for all heights. The independent bundled checker reproduces every coefficient through level five from Fibonacci factorials, checks transitions and higher recurrence levels. Finite experiments supplement, not replace, the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The exact histogram for all 3-adic valuations at the natural 4*3^L triangular scales does not follow as a previously stated conclusion from the inspected mod-three fractal theorem, individual valuation expressions, one-ray asymptotics, or general carry principle. value.rationale: The 4·3^L row heights are intrinsic to the previously studied mod-three Fibonomial fractal. The exact higher-power valuation frequency law is a motivated refinement of the earlier zero/nonzero picture; it gives all strata, sharply bounded maximal valuation, and exact multiplicities at every natural scale. It is an exact infinite-family arithmetic invariant with a compact two-pole generating function, not a numerical curiosity or a routine restatement of the entrywise valuation.
